entities.summary: TV4 Komedi was a sister subchannel of Swedish TV4, owned by TV4 Group. The channel focuses on comedy only with sitcoms, comedy shows and talk shows. The channel airs classic sitcoms like ALF, Family Matters, Cheers, Hope & Faith, Roseanne, Will & Grace, The Golden Girls together with newer shows such as the Late Show with David Letterman, 30 Rock and Parks and Recreation.
